# tests

> Test topology for serialization, domain-organized RPC, wasm ABI, fixtures, and
> optional cross-language e2e interoperability.

## Key Concepts

- [../build.zig](../build.zig) defines canonical test steps; [../Justfile](../Justfile)
  provides contributor-friendly wrappers.
- `zig build test` runs serialization, RPC, and wasm host ABI groups.
- RPC source and tests are organized by domain. The focused RPC build steps are
  `test-rpc-wire`, `test-rpc-caps`, `test-rpc-promises`,
  `test-rpc-transport`, `test-rpc-peer`, `test-rpc-integration`, and optional
  `test-rpc-quic`.
- Fixture-heavy suites rely on vendored Cap'n Proto assets and optional external
  tooling (`capnp`, Python/pycapnp) for full coverage.
- `tests/e2e/` is an optional interop harness across Zig/C++/Go/Rust/Python
  implementations.

## Structure

- [serialization/](serialization/): Message, codegen, schema-validation,
  integration, interop, and fixture suites.
- [rpc/wire/](rpc/wire/): Framing and RPC protocol tests.
- [rpc/caps/](rpc/caps/): Capability-table and release/failure tests.
- [rpc/promises/](rpc/promises/): Promise/pipelining tests.
- [rpc/transport/](rpc/transport/): Transport and raw-frame security tests.
- [rpc/transport/tcp/](rpc/transport/tcp/): TCP connection tests.
- [rpc/transport/quic/](rpc/transport/quic/): QUIC transport tests.
- [rpc/peer/](rpc/peer/): Peer state machine, callbacks, cleanup, and advanced
  peer semantics tests.
- [rpc/integration/](rpc/integration/): HostPeer and WorkerPool tests.
- [rpc/support/](rpc/support/): Shared fixture tooling.
- [capnp_testdata/](capnp_testdata/): Official-style Cap'n Proto schema/fixture
  data.
- [interop/](interop/): Cross-language fixture generation/verification helpers.
- [test_schemas/](test_schemas/): `.capnp` fixtures used by codegen/integration
  tests.
- [golden/](golden/): Golden generated Zig output snapshots.
- [e2e/](e2e/): Multi-language e2e harness (optional in many local workflows).

## Key Files

- [../build.zig](../build.zig): Authoritative test graph and cumulative RPC step
  dependencies.
- [../Justfile](../Justfile): Main entrypoints (`just test*`, e2e wrappers).
- [serialization/codegen_golden_test.zig](serialization/codegen_golden_test.zig):
  Snapshot codegen assertions against [golden/](golden/).
- [serialization/capnp_testdata_test.zig](serialization/capnp_testdata_test.zig):
  Official fixture validation.
- [serialization/capnp_test_vendor_test.zig](serialization/capnp_test_vendor_test.zig):
  Vendor fixture integration checks.
- [serialization/interop_test.zig](serialization/interop_test.zig): Validates
  committed interop fixtures.
- [serialization/interop_roundtrip_test.zig](serialization/interop_roundtrip_test.zig):
  Python-assisted roundtrip and random fixtures.
- [wasm_host_abi_test.zig](wasm_host_abi_test.zig): Host ABI behavior tests with
  RPC fixture helpers.
- [rpc/support/rpc_fixture_tool.zig](rpc/support/rpc_fixture_tool.zig): Shared
  fixture generation utility.

## Development

- Full suite: `just test` or `zig build test --summary all`
- Documentation/API smoke: `just docs-smoke` or
  `zig build docs-smoke --summary all`
- Documentation snippet fixtures: `just test-docs-snippets` or
  `zig build test-docs-snippets --summary all`
- Optional QUIC documentation snippet fixtures:
  `just test-docs-snippets-quic` or
  `zig build -Dquic=true test-docs-snippets-quic --summary all`
- Serialization: `just test-serialization` or `zig build test-serialization --summary all`
- RPC aggregate: `just test-rpc` or `zig build test-rpc --summary all`
- RPC domain suites: `just test-rpc-wire`, `just test-rpc-caps`,
  `just test-rpc-promises`, `just test-rpc-transport`, `just test-rpc-peer`,
  `just test-rpc-integration`, and `just test-rpc-quic`
- Focused suites: `zig build test-message`, `zig build test-codegen`,
  `zig build test-integration`, `zig build test-interop`,
  `zig build test-real-world`, `zig build test-union`,
  `zig build test-capnp-testdata`, `zig build test-capnp-test-vendor`,
  `zig build test-schema-validation`

## Optional

- [e2e/README.md](e2e/README.md): E2E model, supported languages, and execution
  modes.
- [e2e/Justfile](e2e/Justfile): E2E targets and filters.
- [e2e/run_tests.sh](e2e/run_tests.sh): Compatibility wrapper script for E2E
  execution.
